course_name_original: Sistemas de Producción y Fabricación Industrial

learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate the ability to analyze and synthesize.
Demonstrate skills for planning, organization, and strategy.
Acquire the ability to solve problems effectively.
Express oneself correctly in Spanish, both orally and in writing.
Develop the ability to work in a team.
Acquire commitment to ethics and social responsibility.
Acquire the ability for autonomous learning and concern for knowledge and continuous training.
Basic knowledge of production and manufacturing systems.
Ability to organize, plan, and manage within the business, and other institutions and organizations.

syllabus_topics: The ISO fundamental tolerance system. Fundamental concepts.
Group of ISO nominal dimensions up to 500 mm.
Group of ISO nominal dimensions over 500 mm.
DIMENSIONAL STANDARDS, INSTRUMENTS, AND MEASURING MACHINES
Fizeau interferometer. Measurement of gauge blocks.
Qualities and characteristics of gauge blocks.
Materials and care of gauge blocks.
International system of units of measurement.

Relationship between a dimension's tolerance and measurement uncertainty.
Relationship between measurement uncertainty and scale division.
PRACTICAL 1. Measurement of a part with a caliper.
PRACTICAL 2. Measurement of a part with an outside micrometer.
PRACTICAL 3. Measurement of a part with a profile projector.
PRACTICAL 4. Measurement of dimensions by comparison.
teaching_methods: Topic control (5-minute exercises with questions on objectives)
Completion of assignments, reports, memoirs, and evaluation tests
assessment_rules: A minimum score of 40% is required in each assessed component. For exceptional evaluation, a minimum of 50% is required to pass the module and the course. For the second call, the Manufacturing module requires a written exam covering failed parts (theory, problems, practicals). The Production module for the second call requires a full written exam (20% theory, 40% problems), with practicals recoverable by submission.
